description: A UTF-8 encoded surrogate code point is accepted inside a quoted string
notes: The spec says invalid or non-normalized UTF-8 is always a parse error, and ED A0 80 encodes the surrogate U+D800, which is not a Unicode scalar value. hashicorp/hcl's AnyUTF8 rule in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl only checks that a lead byte is followed by the right number of continuation bytes, so string literals accept it. Comparing the string with itself makes an implementation evaluate it without putting the bytes in the result.
